description.value: New York Fries is a Canadian fast-food chain specializing in hand-cut, skin-on fries cooked in non-hydrogenated sunflower oil, alongside poutines made with real Quebec cheese curd and premium loaded hot dogs. The Victoria outlet on Douglas Street is a convenient downtown stop for cyclists passing through the city centre. The menu includes clearly labelled vegetarian, vegan-friendly, and gluten-friendly options.
